mapper.select: SELECT q.id AS quote_sheet_id, d.product_id, p.code, p.name, p.short_name, p.sku_code, p.spec, p.unit, d.sale_price FROM tbl_quote_sheet q INNER JOIN tbl_quote_sheet_detail d ON d.quote_sheet_id = q.id INNER JOIN base_data_product p ON p.id = d.product_id WHERE q.status = 1 AND q.start_date <= #{vo.orderDate} AND q.end_date >= #{vo.orderDate} ORDER BY p.code
